title: Desert Skiff
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Bantha-II cargo skiffs were very common repulsor-based skiffs, widely available and highly durable. They were ideal for the desert climes of Tatooine as a transport for troops, crew, or even slaves—as was the case of Jabba the Hutt and his criminal concern. Those to be executed were transported into the Great Pit of Carkoon. Equipped with planks, the skiffs were well-suited to the job of disposing these criminals. Unfortunately, the skiffs were not Lightsaber-proof.
